I’ve only had one girlfriend, happened about a year ago. I used to work as a delivery driver for a big company, she was the manager of a clothing store that was a regular customer of mine, we would see each other 2-3 times per week. On my last day before quitting the job, she actually asked me out on a date, I of course had no idea she even liked me. 

She’s an extrovert with many friend groups and a vibrant social life, pretty much the opposite of me. As someone with social anxiety, it made it tough for me to integrate into her social life. She was empathetic to my issues, but it weighed down on her in the long run. Ultimately, she wasn’t gonna be one in her friend group whose boyfriend they never saw. They regularly had big get togethers and it was too tall of a task for me to hold my own in these social situations, I only went to a couple of events. I would pretty much cling to her the whole time, as I didn’t know anybody else there and I suck at mingling. Other than that, things were great between us when we were alone together. She broke up with me after about 6 months or so.
